shortDescription: Sri Lanka's Colombo Consumer Price Index rose 8% year-on-year in August, after a 7.3% rise last month, the Statistics Department said on Monday.The index (LKCCPI=ECI), a leading indicator for broader national prices, tracks inflation in Sri Lanka's capital.

children: Sri Lanka's Colombo Consumer Price Index rose 8% year-on-year in August, after a 7.3% rise last month, the Statistics Department said on Monday.
The index (LKCCPI=ECI), a leading indicator for broader national prices, tracks inflation in Sri Lanka's capital.
